paths.return: No early error return for stop, I2C, sleep, or printk; common cleanup is used
0 after setup and success log; payload/readback loops are skipped

ignored_failures.important_case: read error is not returned directly; zero-initialized or stale scratch is still compared, which can produce -ERANGE or success depending on bytes

bounds_and_known_defect.issue: ram_load allows firmware size >=3; target reads u16 at container->data+2 (bytes 2 and 3) without a len>=4 check, so a 3-byte payload can be read out of bounds.
bounds_and_known_defect.policy: Do not silently add a behavior-changing guard to the stock-equivalent candidate; log this as a known stock defect.

branch_evidence: AArch64 stock assembly .text+0xbc0..0xf28 and repaired Ghidra P-Code
